note: I022 cabin windows: openings in the illustrated cabin's wall band (cabin-local units; the bow is +x, port is -y). 'at' is the opening's centre, 'length' along the wall, 'thickness' across it, 'angle' the wall's slope in degrees, 'side' port or starboard. Read by src/boat/cabin_windows.gd. Proof of concept: the Starling 33 (Wing 33) saloon, three windows each side above the settees, clear of the world map.
